name: Delusion
source:
You are going to work like you always do but somethings off... can you escape this Backrooms inspired game, or will you succumb to whatever is lurking in the shadows.

你像往常一样动身去上班，却总觉得哪里不对劲……在这部受“后室”（Backrooms）启发而生的游戏中，你究竟能够成功逃脱，还是会沦为暗影潜伏之物的猎物？
